mode: Applied engineering solution supplied with Codex assistance; no independent authorship claimed.
primary_estimand: Mean paired abs(target-HGB_history) minus abs(target-HGB_history_weather), MWmed. Positive favours history+weather.
supplementary_estimand: Mean paired abs(target-persistence) minus abs(target-HGB_history_weather), MWmed. This answers a separate baseline question.

method.unit: Consecutive hourly paired error deltas; circular wrapping stays within each fold.
method.stratification: Fixed observed folds; preserve n per fold in every replica.
method.aggregation: Fold means weighted by n; interval from combined weighted replicas.
method.block_selection: Report all three lengths; do not select by interval sign.
method.nonpositive_fraction: Descriptive bootstrap fraction, never a p-value.
method.no_iid_replacement_for_time: No IID bootstrap will be used as temporal evidence.

transfer_comparison: Compare h6 and h24 conditional analyses and fold sensitivity. Horizons have different targets; no causal test of horizon superiority or uncomputed CI for their difference is claimed.
baseline_adapter: Create a separate derived CSV: preserve origin/target/fold/observed/candidate, store original HGB history explicitly, map persistence into CLI reference field hgb_history and recompute its paired delta. Labels in analysis identify persistence, not HGB.
source_scope: Saved 504-row development predictions per horizon, already examined/selected historically; not new holdout. No training or inference.
verification_plan: Validate input/metadata/protocol hashes and prior M02-05 method/59-case receipt; do not rerun that test suite.
Recompute every stored absolute error and paired delta from saved rows.
Validate command exit, source/code/output hashes, n/fold/time grids and all 12 summary rows per comparison.
Reconcile all point estimates/MAEs with direct calculations and n-weighted folds; check finite ordered intervals and descriptive fractions.
Report all folds, all blocks and both estimands, preserving historical metrics and runs.
excluded: New predictive test or new data
Claim of contamination-free or operational validity
